name: Nelis
summary: Nelis places the middle top and central leg in dark grey matte elm veneer, giving the core a warm, structured texture. The two side tops and outer legs shift to silvery grey travertine marble, adding a cool, refined stone contrast that expands the visual rhythm of the piece. Matte black metal connectors tie everything together with a sharp, modern edge, completing a design that feels composed and confidently elevated. The middle top and leg cover with elm veneer in dark grey matt. two side top and other legs with slivery grey travertine marble. the metal connect parts in matt black color. 164x50x76
